# Rawr-Rebuffed 0.3.26: patches on the Rawr 2.3.23 source

Generated by patch_source.py after make_build_tree.py. Each patch is an exact text replacement.

## R01 `Rawr.Base/WebRequests.cs` (x1)

web requests time out after 5 s (default 100 s): the icon and item hosts of 2010 are dead, and Rawr blocked for minutes at start-up while the splash screen said 'Loading'

old:
```
                    httpRequest.CookieContainer = cookieContainer;
```
new:
```
                    httpRequest.CookieContainer = cookieContainer;
                    httpRequest.Timeout = 5000;   // Rebuffed: dead hosts must not block the UI
                    httpRequest.ReadWriteTimeout = 5000;
```

## R02 `Rawr.Base/Properties/NetworkSettings.Designer.cs` (x1)

item icons from a live host (wowhead's icon CDN, same file names) instead of the dead 2010 armory address

old:
```
[global::System.Configuration.DefaultSettingValueAttribute("http://www.wowarmory.com/wow-icons/_images/64x64/")]
```
new:
```
[global::System.Configuration.DefaultSettingValueAttribute("https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/")]
```

## R12 `Rawr.Base/WebRequests.cs` (x1)

a timeout, DNS failure or refused connection stops further downloads for the session regardless of the UI language (the original matched the English exception text only; on a German Windows every dead talent icon cost the full timeout, one after the other)

old:
```
				|| ex.Message.Contains("The remote name could not be resolved") /* DNS problems*/
```
new:
```
				|| ex.Message.Contains("The remote name could not be resolved") /* DNS problems*/
				|| (ex is System.Net.WebException && ((System.Net.WebException)ex).Status != System.Net.WebExceptionStatus.ProtocolError) /* Rebuffed: timeout, DNS, connect failure */
```

## E13 `Rawr.Enhance/CalculationOptionsEnhance.cs` (x1)

characters saved before this version get the Lava Burst entry when their priority list loads

old:
```
        public SerializableDictionary<EnhanceAbility, Priority> PriorityList { get { return _priorityList; } set { _priorityList = value; SortPriorities(); OnPropertyChanged("PriorityList"); } }
```
new:
```
        public SerializableDictionary<EnhanceAbility, Priority> PriorityList { get { return _priorityList; } set { _priorityList = value; EnsureRebuffedPriorities(); SortPriorities(); OnPropertyChanged("PriorityList"); } }
        // Rebuffed: a character file saved before 0.2.0 has no Lava Burst entry
        private void EnsureRebuffedPriorities()
        {
            if (_priorityList != null && !_priorityList.ContainsKey(EnhanceAbility.LavaBurst))
                _priorityList.Add(EnhanceAbility.LavaBurst, new Priority("Lava Burst on Lava Surge (Doomhammer)", EnhanceAbility.LavaBurst, "Use the instant Lava Burst that Lava Surge grants (Doomhammer equipped or Lava Surge option on)", false, _priorityList.Count + 1, "SLVB"));
        }
        // Rebuffed: Lava Surge without Doomhammer in the main hand (e.g. to compare)
        private bool _lavaSurge = false;
        public bool LavaSurge { get { return _lavaSurge; } set { _lavaSurge = value; OnPropertyChanged("LavaSurge"); } }
```

## E18 `Rawr.Enhance/CalculationsEnhance.cs` (x1)

Lava Burst DPS: 1192-1518 + 0.5714 SP (WoWSims lavaburst.go), Call of Flame +2% per point, always a crit while Flame Shock is on the target (3.3.5), cast as often as Lava Surge and the priority queue allow

old:
```
                dpsFireNova = (FireNovaNormal + FireNovaCrit) * bonusFireDamage * bossFireResistance * cs.MultiTargetMultiplier;
            }
            #endregion
```
new:
```
                dpsFireNova = (FireNovaNormal + FireNovaCrit) * bonusFireDamage * bossFireResistance * cs.MultiTargetMultiplier;
            }
            #endregion

            #region Lava Burst DPS (Lava Surge, Rebuffed)
            float dpsLvB = 0f;
            if (calcOpts.PriorityInUse(EnhanceAbility.LavaBurst) && cs.LavaSurgeRate > 0f)
            {
                float callOfFlameLvB = 1f + .02f * character.ShamanTalents.CallOfFlame;
                float damageLvB = (1355f + 0.5714f * spellPower) * concussionMultiplier * callOfFlameLvB;
                float LvBdps = damageLvB / cs.AbilityCooldown(EnhanceAbility.LavaBurst);
                dpsLvB = LvBdps * cs.SpellHitModifier * cs.CritMultiplierSpell * bonusFireDamage * bossFireResistance;
            }
            #endregion
```

## W01 `Rawr.DPSWarr/Skills.Arms.cs` (x1)

Forgotten Souls: melee attacks (auto attacks and abilities, proc flags 0x14 of spell 80972) invoke a soul; at 4 souls an instant attack for 100% weapon damage. Modelled like Sword Specialization (same attack table, no GCD, rage like a white swing). PROC RATE UNVERIFIED: the spell's first effect value is 3, read as 3 PPM

old:
```
    public class Swordspec : Ability
    {
```
new:
```
    // Rebuffed: Armata Strigoi (Whitemane legendary 130031), equip effect 'Scream of the Damned' (client spell 80972)
    public class ForgottenSouls : Ability
    {
        public const float SCREAM_PPM = 3f;      // UNVERIFIED - measure with a combat log (souls per minute / 1 PPM = hits per minute * speed / 60)
        public const int SOULS_NEEDED = 4;
        public ForgottenSouls(Character c, Stats s, CombatFactors cf, WhiteAttacks wa, CalculationOptionsDPSWarr co, BossOptions bo)
        {
            Char = c; StatS = s; combatFactors = cf; Whiteattacks = wa; CalcOpts = co; BossOpts = bo;
            Name = "Forgotten Souls (Armata Strigoi)";
            Description = "Melee attacks invoke Forgotten Souls; at 4 souls an instant attack for 100% weapon damage with Armata Strigoi. Proc rate assumed 3 PPM.";
            ReqTalent = false;
            Cd = 0f;
            StanceOkFury = StanceOkArms = StanceOkDef = true;
            DamageBase = combatFactors.AvgMhWeaponDmgUnhasted;
            RageCost = -Whiteattacks.MHSwingRage;
            UsesGCD = false;
            Initialize();
            MHAtkTable = Whiteattacks.MHAtkTable;
        }
        public override bool Validated
        {
            get
            {
                return base.Validated && Char.MainHand != null && Char.MainHand.Item != null && Char.MainHand.Item.Id == 130031;
            }
        }
        public float GetActivates(float YellowsThatLandOverDur)
        {
            if (!Validated) { return 0f; }
            float landedPerSec = (YellowsThatLandOverDur + Whiteattacks.LandedAtksOverDur) / FightDuration;
            float chancePerHit = Math.Min(1f, SCREAM_PPM * combatFactors._c_mhItemSpeed / 60f);
            return landedPerSec * chancePerHit / SOULS_NEEDED * FightDuration;
        }
    }

    public class Swordspec : Ability
    {
```

```
        public AbilWrapper GetWrapper<T>()
        {
```

```
        }

        // Rebuffed: Armata Strigoi - returns the DPS of the Forgotten Souls attacks for the caller to add
        protected float calcForgottenSouls()
        {
            if (!AbilityList.ContainsKey(typeof(Skills.ForgottenSouls))) return 0f;
            AbilWrapper fs = GetWrapper<Skills.ForgottenSouls>();
            if (!fs.ability.Validated) return 0f;
            fs.numActivates = (fs.ability as Skills.ForgottenSouls).GetActivates(LandedYellowsOverDur);
            return fs.allDPS;
        }
```

## E33 `Rawr.Enhance/CalculationsEnhance.cs` (x1)

Thunderblade DPS: procs on hits of the carrying hand (PPM x hits/s x speed/60), 15% of that hand's weapon damage as Nature damage, spell hit, spell crit x1.5 (client 55864: DmgClass magic), no armor

old:
```
            #region Lavalash DPS
```
new:

```
            #region Thunderblade DPS (Thunderfury 132003, Rebuffed)
            float dpsThunderblade = 0f;
            bool tfMH = character.MainHand != null && character.MainHand.Id == 132003;
            bool tfOH = character.OffHand != null && character.OffHand.Id == 132003;
            if ((tfMH || tfOH) && calcOpts.ThunderfuryPPM > 0f)
            {
                float tfProcsPerS = tfMH ? cs.HitsPerSMH * calcOpts.ThunderfuryPPM * cs.UnhastedMHSpeed / 60f : cs.HitsPerSOH * calcOpts.ThunderfuryPPM * cs.UnhastedOHSpeed / 60f;
                float tfDamage = 0.15f * (tfMH ? damageMHSwing : damageOHSwing);
                float tfCrit = (1f - cs.ChanceSpellCrit) + cs.ChanceSpellCrit * cs.CritMultiplierSpell;
                dpsThunderblade = tfProcsPerS * tfDamage * cs.ChanceSpellHit * tfCrit * bonusNatureDamage * bossNatureResistance;
            }
            #endregion

            #region Lavalash DPS
```

## E42 `Rawr.Enhance/CalculationsEnhance.cs` (x1)

Frostbrand Attack DPS: 530 Frost + 10% of spell power per proc (58799), spell hit and crit, 8.5 PPM like EnhSim (server-side, UNVERIFIED)

old:
```
            #region Thunderblade DPS (Thunderfury 132003, Rebuffed)
```

```
            #region Frostbrand DPS (Rebuffed 0.3.1)
            float dpsFrostbrand = 0f;
            bool fbMH = calcOpts.MainhandImbue == "Frostbrand";
            bool fbOH = calcOpts.OffhandImbue == "Frostbrand" && character.ShamanTalents.DualWield == 1;
            if (fbMH || fbOH)
            {   // Frostbrand Attack rank 9 (58799): 530 Frost damage + 10% of spell power; the proc rate is server-side, 8.5 PPM as in EnhSim (UNVERIFIED)
                const float fbPPM = 8.5f;
                float fbProcsPerS = (fbMH ? cs.HitsPerSMH * fbPPM * cs.UnhastedMHSpeed / 60f : 0f) + (fbOH ? cs.HitsPerSOH * fbPPM * cs.UnhastedOHSpeed / 60f : 0f);
                float fbDamage = 530f + 0.1f * stats.SpellPower;
                float fbCrit = (1f - cs.ChanceSpellCrit) + cs.ChanceSpellCrit * cs.CritMultiplierSpell;
                dpsFrostbrand = fbProcsPerS * fbDamage * cs.ChanceSpellHit * fbCrit * (1f + stats.BonusFrostDamageMultiplier);   // the model has no frost resistance input
            }
            #endregion

            #region Thunderblade DPS (Thunderfury 132003, Rebuffed)
```

```
                        hitsThatProcWFPerS += moteHitsPerS; // if no offhand then all motes will be MH weapon by definition
                    float maxExpectedWFPerFight = hitsThatProcWFPerS * chanceToProcWFPerHit * fightLength;
                    float ineligibleSeconds = maxExpectedWFPerFight * (3.25f - hastedMHSpeed);
                    float expectedWFPerFight = hitsThatProcWFPerS * chanceToProcWFPerHit * (fightLength - ineligibleSeconds);
                    wfProcsPerSecond = expectedWFPerFight / fightLength;
                    hitsPerSWF = 2f * wfProcsPerSecond * (1f - chanceYellowMissMH);
                }
                yellowHitsPerSMH = hitsPerSWF + hitsPerSMHSS;
                yellowHitsPerSOH = hitsPerSOHSS + hitsPerSLL;
```
new:
```
                // Windfury model (Rebuffed 0.3.2): 20% per landed hit of EVERY Windfury-imbued weapon, one shared 3 s cooldown
                // (measured on Whitemane 2026-10-14, WF/WF: main-hand procs as 25504, off-hand procs as 33750, 10.8 procs/min at
                // 1.7-2.1 landed hits/s, no cross-hand gap under 3 s). After the cooldown the next proc waits for a proccing hit:
                // procs/s = 1 / (3 s + 1 / (chance x eligible hits/s)); the hands share the procs by their eligible hits.
                bool wfMH = _calcOpts.MainhandImbue == "Windfury";
                bool wfOH = _calcOpts.OffhandImbue == "Windfury" && _character.ShamanTalents.DualWield == 1;
                if (wfMH || wfOH)
                {
                    float wfHitsMH = wfMH ? whiteHitsPerSMH + hitsPerSMHSS + (_character.ShamanTalents.DualWield == 1 ? moteHitsPerS / 2 : moteHitsPerS) : 0f;
                    float wfHitsOH = wfOH ? whiteHitsPerSOH + hitsPerSOHSS + hitsPerSLL + moteHitsPerS / 2 : 0f;
                    float wfEligiblePerS = (wfHitsMH + wfHitsOH) * chanceToProcWFPerHit;
                    wfProcsPerSecond = wfEligiblePerS > 0f ? 1f / (3.0f + 1f / wfEligiblePerS) : 0f;
                    float wfShareMH = wfHitsMH + wfHitsOH > 0f ? wfHitsMH / (wfHitsMH + wfHitsOH) : 0f;
                    hitsPerSWF = 2f * wfProcsPerSecond * wfShareMH * (1f - chanceYellowMissMH);
                    hitsPerSWFOH = 2f * wfProcsPerSecond * (1f - wfShareMH) * (1f - chanceYellowMissOH);
                }
                yellowHitsPerSMH = hitsPerSWF + hitsPerSMHSS;
                yellowHitsPerSOH = hitsPerSOHSS + hitsPerSLL + hitsPerSWFOH;
```

## E49g `Rawr.Enhance/CalculationsEnhance.cs` (x1)

Windfury DPS from both hands: off-hand procs swing the off hand (half weapon damage and half of the 1250 AP bonus - measured 412 vs 850 non-crit per attack)

old:
```
            float dpsWF = 0f;
            if (calcOpts.MainhandImbue == "Windfury")
            {
                float damageWFHit = damageMHSwing + (windfuryWeaponBonus / 14 * cs.UnhastedMHSpeed);
                float WFdps = damageWFHit * cs.HitsPerSWF;
                float WFnormal = WFdps * cs.YellowHitModifierMH;
                float WFcrit = WFdps * cs.YellowCritModifierMH * cs.CritMultiplierMelee;
                dpsWF = (WFnormal + WFcrit) * weaponMastery * cs.DamageReduction * bonusPhysicalDamage * windfuryDamageBonus;
            }
```
new:
```
            float dpsWF = 0f;
            if (cs.HitsPerSWF > 0f || cs.HitsPerSWFOH > 0f)   // Rebuffed 0.3.2: either hand may carry Windfury
            {
                float damageWFHit = damageMHSwing + (windfuryWeaponBonus / 14 * cs.UnhastedMHSpeed);
                float WFdps = damageWFHit * cs.HitsPerSWF;
                float WFnormal = WFdps * cs.YellowHitModifierMH;
                float WFcrit = WFdps * cs.YellowCritModifierMH * cs.CritMultiplierMelee;
                // off-hand procs (33750) swing the off hand: damageOHSwing already carries the 50% off-hand factor, the AP bonus gets it here
                float damageWFHitOH = damageOHSwing + (windfuryWeaponBonus / 14 * cs.UnhastedOHSpeed) * .5f;
                float WFdpsOH = damageWFHitOH * cs.HitsPerSWFOH;
                float WFnormalOH = WFdpsOH * cs.YellowHitModifierOH;
                float WFcritOH = WFdpsOH * cs.YellowCritModifierOH * cs.CritMultiplierMelee;
                dpsWF = (WFnormal + WFcrit + WFnormalOH + WFcritOH) * weaponMastery * cs.DamageReduction * bonusPhysicalDamage * windfuryDamageBonus;
            }
```

```
        private string expertiseCapLine(float expertise)   // Rebuffed 0.3.4: distance to the 26 expertise (6.50% dodge) cap of a level-83 boss
        {
            float delta = expertise - 26f;
            float rating = (float)Math.Abs(delta) * StatConversion.GetRatingFromExpertise(1f);
            string where = delta > 0.5f ? String.Format("over by {0} = {1} rating wasted", delta.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), rating.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                : delta < 0f ? String.Format("under by {0} = {1} more rating", (-delta).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), rating.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                : "at the cap";
            return String.Format("{0}/26 expertise = {1}% of 6.50% dodge reduction ({2})", expertise.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                (expertise * 0.25f).ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), where);
        }

        private String getExpertiseString()
        {   // using 26.5 for display purposes as its pointless warning over cap if 26.1 Expertise for example.
            String caps = "";
            if (TotalExpertiseMH == TotalExpertiseOH)
            {
                if (TotalExpertiseMH > 26.5f)
                    caps = "{0} (Over Cap)*{5}\r\n{1} Expertise\r\n{2} Expertise Rating\r\n{3}% Dodged\r\n{4}% Parried";
                else if (TotalExpertiseMH < 26)
                    caps = "{0} (Under Cap)*{5}\r\n{1} Expertise\r\n{2} Expertise Rating\r\n{3}% Dodged\r\n{4}% Parried";
                else
                    caps = "{0}*{5}\r\n{1} Expertise\r\n{2} Expertise Rating\r\n{3}% Dodged\r\n{4}% Parried";
                return String.Format(caps,
                    TotalExpertiseMH.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    BasicStats.Expertise.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    BasicStats.ExpertiseRating.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    DodgedAttacks.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    ParriedAttacks.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                    expertiseCapLine(TotalExpertiseMH));
            }
```

## E52c `Rawr.Enhance/CharacterCalculationsEnhance.cs` (x1)

hitCapLine(): '446 -79 (-3%) -26 (-1%) -79 (talent -3%) = 262 | 374 (+112)' - rating for 17%, minus each active source, the rating needed, the rating worn, the difference

old:
```
        private string expertiseCapLine(float expertise)
```
new:
```
        private string hitCapLine()   // Rebuffed 0.3.5: numbers only - what 17% costs in rating, minus every active hit source, the rating needed vs worn
        {
            float perPct = 1f / (StatConversion.GetSpellHitFromRating(1f) * 100f);
            float need = 17f * perPct;
            string line = Math.Round(need).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            float debuff = SpellHitDebuffOn ? 3f : 0f, hp = HeroicPresenceOn ? 1f : 0f, talent = ElementalPrecisionRank;
            float other = SpellHitFlatPct - debuff - hp - talent;
            if (debuff > 0f) { line += String.Format(" -{0} (-{1}%)", Math.Round(debuff * perPct).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), debuff.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)); need -= debuff * perPct; }
            if (hp > 0f) { line += String.Format(" -{0} (-{1}%)", Math.Round(hp * perPct).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), hp.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)); need -= hp * perPct; }
            if (talent > 0f) { line += String.Format(" -{0} (talent -{1}%)", Math.Round(talent * perPct).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), talent.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)); need -= talent * perPct; }
            if (Math.Abs(other) > 0.05f) { line += String.Format(" {0}{1} ({2}%)", other > 0 ? "-" : "+", Math.Round(Math.Abs(other) * perPct).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), (-other).ToString("+0.#;-0.#", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)); need -= other * perPct; }
            float diff = BasicStats.HitRating - need;
            return String.Format("{0} = {1} | {2} ({3})", line, Math.Round(need).ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                BasicStats.HitRating.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), diff.ToString("+0;-0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }

        private string expertiseCapLine(float expertise)
```

```
		// Rebuffed 0.3.15: raid buffs and debuffs a CharacterProfiler import starts with (reference T7 profile, no consumables)
		public static readonly string[] RebuffedRaidBuffs = {
			"Blessing of Kings", "Strength of Earth Totem", "Enhancing Totems (Agility/Strength)", "Blessing of Might",
			"Improved Blessing of Might", "Unleashed Rage", "Sanctified Retribution", "Swift Retribution", "Commanding Shout",
			"Arcane Intellect", "Leader of the Pack", "Improved Leader of the Pack", "Windfury Totem", "Improved Windfury Totem",
			"Judgements of the Wise", "Blessing of Wisdom", "Improved Blessing of Wisdom", "Hymn of Hope", "Mana Tide Totem",
			"Moonkin Form", "Wrath of Air Totem", "Flametongue Totem", "Enhancing Totems (Spell Power)", "Divine Spirit",
			"Power Word: Fortitude", "Improved Power Word: Fortitude", "Mark of the Wild", "Improved Mark of the Wild",
			"Heroism/Bloodlust", "Sunder Armor", "Faerie Fire", "Heart of the Crusader", "Judgement of Wisdom", "Blood Frenzy",
			"Improved Shadow Bolt", "Curse of the Elements", "Improved Faerie Fire" };

		// the Armory import's model rule (Armory.cs), on the talents just read
		public static string RebuffedModelFromTalents(Character c)
		{
			switch (c.Class)
			{
				case CharacterClass.Warrior: return c.WarriorTalents.Devastate > 0 ? "ProtWarr" : "DPSWarr";
				case CharacterClass.Paladin: return c.PaladinTalents.HolyShield > 0 ? "ProtPaladin" : (c.PaladinTalents.CrusaderStrike > 0 ? "Retribution" : "Healadin");
				case CharacterClass.Hunter: return "Hunter";
				case CharacterClass.Rogue: return "Rogue";
				case CharacterClass.Priest: return c.PriestTalents.Shadowform > 0 ? "ShadowPriest" : "HealPriest";
				case CharacterClass.Shaman: return c.ShamanTalents.ElementalMastery > 0 ? "Elemental" : (c.ShamanTalents.Stormstrike > 0 ? "Enhance" : "RestoSham");
				case CharacterClass.Mage: return "Mage";
				case CharacterClass.Warlock: return "Warlock";
				case CharacterClass.Druid: return c.DruidTalents.ProtectorOfThePack > 0 ? "Bear" : (c.DruidTalents.LeaderOfThePack > 0 ? "Cat" : (c.DruidTalents.MoonkinForm > 0 ? "Moonkin" : "Tree"));
				case CharacterClass.DeathKnight: return c.DeathKnightTalents.Anticipation > 0 ? "TankDK" : "DPSDK";
				default: return null;
			}
		}

		void RebuffedImportDefaults()
		{
			Character c = m_character;
			if (c == null) return;
			if (m_iLevel >= 10)
			{
				try { string model = RebuffedModelFromTalents(c); if (model != null && Calculations.Models.ContainsKey(model)) c.CurrentModel = model; }
				catch (Exception) { }
			}
			// professions: Skills > Professions > "Engineering" = "450:450" (key "Order" is the addon's sort index)
			List<string> profNames = new List<string>();
			Dictionary<string, int> profRank = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			try
			{
				SavedVariablesDictionary skills = m_characterInfo.ContainsKey("Skills") ? m_characterInfo["Skills"] as SavedVariablesDictionary : null;
				SavedVariablesDictionary profs = (skills != null && skills.ContainsKey("Professions")) ? skills["Professions"] as SavedVariablesDictionary : null;
				if (profs != null)
					foreach (KeyValuePair<IComparable, object> kv in profs)
					{
						string name = kv.Key as string, value = kv.Value as string;
						if (name == null || value == null || name == "Order" || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(Profession), name)) continue;
						int rank = 0;
						int.TryParse(value.Split(':')[0], out rank);
						profNames.Add(name);
						profRank[name] = rank;
					}
			}
			catch (Exception) { }
			profNames.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);
			c.PrimaryProfession = profNames.Count > 0 ? (Profession)Enum.Parse(typeof(Profession), profNames[0]) : Profession.None;
			c.SecondaryProfession = profNames.Count > 1 ? (Profession)Enum.Parse(typeof(Profession), profNames[1]) : Profession.None;
			// raid buffs and debuffs, then the model's class buffs, then the profession buffs
			foreach (string b in RebuffedRaidBuffs)
			{
				Buff buff = Buff.GetBuffByName(b);
				if (buff != null && !c.ActiveBuffs.Contains(buff)) c.ActiveBuffsAdd(b);
			}
			try { if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.CurrentModel)) Calculations.GetModel(c.CurrentModel).SetDefaults(c); }
			catch (Exception) { }
			int r;
			if (profRank.TryGetValue("Mining", out r) && r >= 450 && !c.ActiveBuffs.Contains(Buff.GetBuffByName("Toughness"))) c.ActiveBuffsAdd("Toughness");
			if (profRank.TryGetValue("Skinning", out r) && r >= 450 && !c.ActiveBuffs.Contains(Buff.GetBuffByName("Master of Anatomy"))) c.ActiveBuffsAdd("Master of Anatomy");
			if (profRank.TryGetValue("Blacksmithing", out r) && r >= 400) { c.WristBlacksmithingSocketEnabled = true; c.HandsBlacksmithingSocketEnabled = true; }
		}
```

```
        // Rebuffed 0.3.16: the items of `items` this character owns (RebuffedOwnedItems) or wears in `slot`; the cache keeps the full list
        public List<ItemInstance> RebuffedFilterOwned(CharacterSlot slot, List<ItemInstance> items)
        {
            Dictionary<int, bool> owned = new Dictionary<int, bool>();
            foreach (string s in RebuffedOwnedItems) { int id; if (s != null && int.TryParse(s.Split('.')[0], out id)) owned[id] = true; }
            ItemInstance worn = this[slot];
            List<ItemInstance> keep = new List<ItemInstance>();
            foreach (ItemInstance i in items)
                if (i != null && (owned.ContainsKey(i.Id) || (worn != null && worn.Id == i.Id))) keep.Add(i);
            return keep;
        }

```

```
		// Rebuffed 0.3.16: German client names -> Rawr's Profession names (English names pass unchanged)
		public static string RebuffedProfessionKey(string name)
		{
			switch (name)
			{
				case "Alchimie": return "Alchemy";
				case "Schmiedekunst": return "Blacksmithing";
				case "Verzauberkunst": return "Enchanting";
				case "Ingenieurskunst": return "Engineering";
				case "Kr\u00e4uterkunde": return "Herbalism";
				case "Inschriftenkunde": return "Inscription";
				case "Juwelierskunst": return "Jewelcrafting";
				case "Lederverarbeitung": return "Leatherworking";
				case "Bergbau": return "Mining";
				case "K\u00fcrschnerei": return "Skinning";
				case "Schneiderei": return "Tailoring";
				default: return name;
			}
		}

		static DateTime RebuffedEpoch(long t) { return new DateTime(1970, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddSeconds(t); }

		// Rebuffed 0.3.16: the owned item ids (distinct ids of the import's AvailableItems: equipped, bags, bank) and the
		// import warnings - no bank in the save, bank older than 7 days before the save (timestamp > Bank vs timestamp > init >
		// TimeStamp), no professions; none below level 10
		void RebuffedOwnedAndWarnings(int profCount)
		{
			Character c = m_character;
			c.RebuffedOwnedItems = new List<string>();
			foreach (string s in c.AvailableItems)
			{
				string id = s.Split('.')[0];
				if (!c.RebuffedOwnedItems.Contains(id)) c.RebuffedOwnedItems.Add(id);
			}
			c.RebuffedImportWarnings = new List<string>();
			if (m_iLevel < 10) return;
			long save = 0, bank = 0;
			try
			{
				SavedVariablesDictionary ts = m_characterInfo.ContainsKey("timestamp") ? m_characterInfo["timestamp"] as SavedVariablesDictionary : null;
				if (ts != null)
				{
					if (ts.ContainsKey("Bank") && ts["Bank"] is long) bank = (long)ts["Bank"];
					SavedVariablesDictionary init = ts.ContainsKey("init") ? ts["init"] as SavedVariablesDictionary : null;
					if (init != null && init.ContainsKey("TimeStamp") && init["TimeStamp"] is long) save = (long)init["TimeStamp"];
				}
			}
			catch (Exception) { }
			if (!m_characterInfo.ContainsKey("Bank"))
				c.RebuffedImportWarnings.Add("No bank data in this save: CharacterProfiler saves the bank only while the bank window is open. The bank's items are missing - open the bank in game, press \"save\" in the character window, then load again.");
			else if (bank > 0 && save > 0 && save - bank > 7L * 86400L)
				c.RebuffedImportWarnings.Add(string.Format("The bank data is {0} days older than the rest of this save (bank {1:yyyy-MM-dd}, save {2:yyyy-MM-dd}). Items moved since then are missing or wrong - open the bank in game, press \"save\", then load again.", (save - bank) / 86400L, RebuffedEpoch(bank), RebuffedEpoch(save)));
			if (profCount == 0)
				c.RebuffedImportWarnings.Add("No professions in this save: Rawr leaves both professions empty (no profession bonuses). Set them on the Stats tab by hand if the character has any.");
		}

		// the Armory import's model rule (Armory.cs), on the talents just read
```

```
        // Rebuffed 0.3.16: icon toggle right of "Export" - the gear lists show only the items of the last CharacterProfiler

        private void RebuffedAddOwnedButton()
        {
            _rebuffedOwnedButton = new ToolStripButton();
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.Name = "toolStripButtonRebuffedOwned";
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.CheckOnClick = true;
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.DisplayStyle = ToolStripItemDisplayStyle.Image;
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.ToolTipText = RebuffedOwnedTip;
            try { _rebuffedOwnedButton.Image = ItemIcons.GetItemIcon("inv_misc_bag_10", true); } catch (Exception) { }
            if (_rebuffedOwnedButton.Image == null) { _rebuffedOwnedButton.DisplayStyle = ToolStripItemDisplayStyle.Text; _rebuffedOwnedButton.Text = "Owned"; }
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.Enabled = false;
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.CheckedChanged += new EventHandler(RebuffedOwnedButton_CheckedChanged);
            int at = toolStripItemComparison.Items.IndexOf(toolStripButtonExport);
            toolStripItemComparison.Items.Insert(at + 1, _rebuffedOwnedButton);
        }

        private void RebuffedOwnedButton_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_rebuffedOwnedUpdating || _character == null) return;
            _character.RebuffedOwnedOnly = _rebuffedOwnedButton.Checked;
            LoadComparisonData();
        }

        private void RebuffedUpdateOwnedButton()
        {
            if (_rebuffedOwnedButton == null || _character == null) return;
            bool has = _character.RebuffedOwnedItems != null && _character.RebuffedOwnedItems.Count > 0;
            _rebuffedOwnedUpdating = true;
            if (!has) _character.RebuffedOwnedOnly = false;
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.Enabled = has;
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.Checked = _character.RebuffedOwnedOnly;
            _rebuffedOwnedButton.ToolTipText = has ? RebuffedOwnedTip + " (" + _character.RebuffedOwnedItems.Count + " items)" : RebuffedOwnedTip + " - needs File > Load from Character Profiler";
            _rebuffedOwnedUpdating = false;
        }

        private void RebuffedShowImportWarnings(Character c)
        {
            if (c == null || c.RebuffedImportWarnings == null || c.RebuffedImportWarnings.Count == 0) return;
            MessageBox.Show(this, c.Name + ":\n\n- " + string.Join("\n\n- ", c.RebuffedImportWarnings.ToArray()),
                "Rawr-Rebuffed: CharacterProfiler import", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
        }
```

## E58 `Rawr.Enhance/CalculationsEnhance.cs` (x1)

wolf attack power function and the twin-trinket merge (shared internal cooldown)

old:
```
        #region Get Character Stats
        public override Stats GetCharacterStats(Character character, Item additionalItem)
```
new:
```
        // Rebuffed 0.3.9: Spirit Wolf AP = 311 + 31 % of the owner's sheet AP (+30 % with the glyph), inherited live - fit to
        // four logged wolf pairs (-0.5..-2.8 %). 2.3.23's
        // 331 x 2 - 20 = 642 base, Strength of Earth and x(1 + Unleashed Rage) lay 4.5-15 % above the log.
        public static float RebuffedWolfAttackPower(float ownerAP, bool glyph)
        {
            return 311f + .31f * ownerAP + (glyph ? .3f * ownerAP : 0f);
        }
        public static float RebuffedWolfNakedHit(float ownerAP, bool glyph)
        {
            return (206.17f + RebuffedWolfAttackPower(ownerAP, glyph) / 14f) * 1.5f;   // per landed plain hit before armour
        }

        // Rebuffed 0.3.9: the blue (rare) trinket and its violet Whitemane epic share ONE internal cooldown (seen in game,
        // 2026-10-14); two copies of one trinket are assumed to do the same. 2.3.23 summed both procs as independent effects.
        // The pair becomes one effect: chance 1-(1-p1)(1-p2) (PPM: the sum), the mean of both stat values (whichever
        // procs first wins, equal chances = half each; EnhSim-Rebuffed 0.3.6 links them the same way), the longer cooldown
        // and duration; an on-use pair keeps the better item's effect (one use per shared cooldown). Families = a stock
        // rare and its seven-digit Whitemane epic of the same name (twin_trinkets.py on the item cache).
        private static readonly int[][] RebuffedTwinFamilies = {
            new int[] { 37220, 1206723 }, new int[] { 44063, 1209149 }, new int[] { 42413, 1208535 }, new int[] { 42395, 1208534 },
            new int[] { 37660, 1207053 }, new int[] { 37723, 1207078 }, new int[] { 37872, 1207112 }, new int[] { 37873, 1207113 },
            new int[] { 37390, 1206830 }, new int[] { 37638, 1207040 }, new int[] { 37264, 1206755 }, new int[] { 37166, 1206680 },
            new int[] { 37734, 1207088 }, new int[] { 37844, 1207098 } };
        private static bool RebuffedSameTrinketFamily(int a, int b)
        {
            if (a == b) return true;
            foreach (int[] f in RebuffedTwinFamilies)
                if (Array.IndexOf(f, a) >= 0 && Array.IndexOf(f, b) >= 0) return true;
            return false;
        }
        public static void RebuffedMergeTwinTrinkets(Stats gear, Character character)
        {
            ItemInstance t1 = character.Trinket1, t2 = character.Trinket2;
            if ((object)t1 == null || (object)t2 == null || (object)t1.Item == null || (object)t2.Item == null) return;
            if (!RebuffedSameTrinketFamily(t1.Id, t2.Id)) return;
            SpecialEffect a = null, b = null;
            int na = 0, nb = 0;
            foreach (SpecialEffect e in t1.Item.Stats.SpecialEffects()) { a = e; na++; }
            foreach (SpecialEffect e in t2.Item.Stats.SpecialEffects()) { b = e; nb++; }
            if (na != 1 || nb != 1 || a.Trigger != b.Trigger) return;
            int ia = -1, ib = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < gear._rawSpecialEffectDataSize; i++)
            {
                if (ia < 0 && object.ReferenceEquals(gear._rawSpecialEffectData[i], a)) { ia = i; continue; }
                if (ib < 0 && object.ReferenceEquals(gear._rawSpecialEffectData[i], b)) ib = i;
            }
            if (ia < 0 || ib < 0) return;
            SpecialEffect merged;
            if (a.Trigger == Trigger.Use)
                merged = (t2.Item.ItemLevel > t1.Item.ItemLevel || t2.Item.Quality > t1.Item.Quality) ? b : a;
            else
            {
                float chance = (a.Chance > 0f && b.Chance > 0f) ? 1f - (1f - a.Chance) * (1f - b.Chance)
                             : (a.Chance < 0f && b.Chance < 0f) ? a.Chance + b.Chance : Math.Max(a.Chance, b.Chance);
                merged = new SpecialEffect(a.Trigger, (a.Stats + b.Stats) * 0.5f, Math.Max(a.Duration, b.Duration),
                                           Math.Max(a.Cooldown, b.Cooldown), chance, Math.Max(a.MaxStack, b.MaxStack));
            }
            gear._rawSpecialEffectData[ia] = merged;
            for (int i = ib; i < gear._rawSpecialEffectDataSize - 1; i++) gear._rawSpecialEffectData[i] = gear._rawSpecialEffectData[i + 1];
            gear._rawSpecialEffectDataSize--;
            gear._rawSpecialEffectData[gear._rawSpecialEffectDataSize] = null;
        }

        #region Get Character Stats
        public override Stats GetCharacterStats(Character character, Item additionalItem)
```

## E60 `Rawr.Enhance/StatsSpecialEffects.cs` (x1)

spell power the Fire Elemental gets on top of the average at its summon

old:
```
        private void SetTriggerChanceAndSpeed(SpecialEffect effect)
```
new:
```
        // Rebuffed 0.3.10: surcharge over the averaged spell power for the Fire Elemental's snapshot. On use: popped with the
        // summon (P = 1). Proc: P = up already + caught within the wait (waitSeconds, EnhSim / EnhaPrio 20 s): per proc
        // cycle (up for Duration, then cooldown-only for Cooldown - Duration, then free until the next proc at rate r),
        // a free cooldown catches it with 1 - e^(-rW), a running cooldown only if it ends inside the wait. Stacking
        // effects and weapon enchants are not waited for. Mirrors EnhSim-Rebuffed 0.3.8's wait (Sundial: 43 % caught there).
        public float RebuffedFireElementalSpellPower(float waitSeconds)
        {
            float bonus = 0f;
            foreach (SpecialEffect effect in _stats.SpecialEffects())
            {
                if (effect.Stats.SpellPower <= 0f || effect.MaxStack > 1 || effect == mainHandEnchant || effect == offHandEnchant) continue;
                float value = effect.Stats.SpellPower;
                float average = getSpecialEffects(effect).SpellPower;
                float pUp;
                if (effect.Trigger == Trigger.Use) pUp = 1f;
                else
                {
                    SetTriggerChanceAndSpeed(effect);
                    if (trigger <= 0f) continue;
                    float r = chance * effect.GetChance(unhastedAttackSpeed) / trigger;   // procs per second while free
                    if (r <= 0f) continue;
                    float tUp = effect.Duration, tIcd = Math.Max(0f, effect.Cooldown - effect.Duration), tFree = 1f / r;
                    float cycle = tUp + tIcd + tFree;
                    float W = waitSeconds;
                    float catchFree = (tFree / cycle) * (1f - (float)Math.Exp(-r * W));
                    float catchIcd = 0f;
                    if (tIcd > 0f)
                    {
                        float m = Math.Min(W, tIcd);
                        catchIcd = (tIcd / cycle) * (m - ((float)Math.Exp(-r * (W - m)) - (float)Math.Exp(-r * W)) / r) / tIcd;
                    }
                    pUp = Math.Min(1f, tUp / cycle + catchFree + catchIcd);
                }
                bonus += value * pUp - average;
            }
            return Math.Max(0f, bonus);
        }

        private void SetTriggerChanceAndSpeed(SpecialEffect effect)
```

## E61 `Rawr.Enhance/StatsSpecialEffects.cs` (x1)

the snapshot surcharge by the measured rule (strongest proc, or the on-use effects at the pull)

old:
```
        private void SetTriggerChanceAndSpeed(SpecialEffect effect)
```
new:
```
        // Rebuffed 0.3.11: spPerAp = Mental Quickness share x attack power multiplier x spell power multiplier (as the model
        // turns bonus attack power into spell power). A worn proc (not on use, not stacking, not a weapon enchant): only the
        // strongest counts, at its full value - the elemental waits for it without a limit. None worn: every on-use effect
        // counts at its full value - the elemental goes at the pull together with them.
        public float RebuffedFireElementalSnapshotBonus(float spPerAp)
        {
            SpecialEffect best = null;
            float bestValue = 0f;
            foreach (SpecialEffect effect in _stats.SpecialEffects())
            {
                if (effect.Trigger == Trigger.Use || effect.MaxStack > 1 || effect == mainHandEnchant || effect == offHandEnchant) continue;
                float v = effect.Stats.SpellPower + spPerAp * effect.Stats.AttackPower;
                if (v > bestValue) { best = effect; bestValue = v; }
            }
            if (best != null)
            {
                Stats avg = getSpecialEffects(best);
                return Math.Max(0f, bestValue - (avg.SpellPower + spPerAp * avg.AttackPower));
            }
            float bonus = 0f;
            foreach (SpecialEffect effect in _stats.SpecialEffects())
            {
                if (effect.Trigger != Trigger.Use || effect.MaxStack > 1) continue;
                float v = effect.Stats.SpellPower + spPerAp * effect.Stats.AttackPower;
                if (v <= 0f) continue;
                Stats avg = getSpecialEffects(effect);
                bonus += v - (avg.SpellPower + spPerAp * avg.AttackPower);
            }
            return Math.Max(0f, bonus);
        }

        private void SetTriggerChanceAndSpeed(SpecialEffect effect)
```
